name: claudia
description: Chat with Claude on the left; Claude explains on the right, in a picture it draws.

scripts.build: shadow-cljs release host runner front hub web && npm run build:web-files
scripts.build:web-files: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('resources/web/index.html')){console.error('resources/web/index.html is missing: the page has nothing to load');process.exit(1)}fs.cpSync('resources/web','out/web',{recursive:true})"
